review: R Corp. 4th Pack Reindeer Rodion, like the rest of the Reindeer IDs, is a Charge Sinking Identity who can deal consistent high damage across all her skills once ramped up. Reindeer Rodion’s Passive is probably the most interesting part of her kit. If the enemy does not have any Sinking on them, Rodion will inflict twice the amount of Sinking Potency, leading to a bit more damage and enemy SP loss, especially in a team where she is the only Sinking applier (Envy / Middle team). Additionally, while she is below 35% HP, all her skills get +1 Final Power, helping with clashing at Death’s Door. Next, let's talk about her skills: - Skill 1 - Energy Strike - 'That's What You Get For Giving Us Holiday Shifts!' - 2 Coins - Min roll 11 - Max roll 15 - Decent damage when ramped up due to 50% bonus damage and due to [Clash Lose] condition, Rodion can obtain Charge Count consistently, even if bad Coi
